functionality: download and run additional malicious scripts
send requests to a command and control server
operational_techniques: iterating through image bytes to extract code
triggering execution based on file size
related_malicious_code_snippet: The code snippet analyzes three image files (logo1.jpg, logo2.jpg, and logo3.jpg), but only logo2.jpg (the Microsoft logo) triggers malicious behavior, which registers the infected machine with a remote server (85.208.108.29) using hostname and OS information. Then, it establishes a loop to fetch commands from the server and execute them periodically. The commands can include changing a directory ('cd') or running arbitrary code with the 'exec' function. The execution results are then posted back to the server.
